messages:
incidentbot: [PD] INC-185999: canary-latency-eu-west triggered (>95p 1200ms) — auto-resolve in 5m if stable
maya: ack — I'm on it, looking at canary traces
alex: saw the alert, no errors so far, might be kv warmup. checking grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/canary
maya: quick snapshot: p95 jumped to ~1.3s for ~40s, p50 ~700ms
maya: running `kubectl -n canary get pods -l app=canary -o wide` — one pod restarted ~2m ago
sam: @maya @alex if there are no customer errors, mark as no-impact and watch for auto-resolve
opsbot: PD incident INC-185999 acknowledged by maya
incidentbot: Auto-resolved: alert cleared after 2m 45s — metrics back to baseline
maya: confirmed back to normal, no 5xx in logs. looks like a transient scheduling/coldstart blip
alex: adding todo: tune canary alert to p95 >1500ms for EU region, and add kv-prefill to canary startup to reduce warmup
maya: filing a quick follow-up ticket in #eng-sre for suppression / tuning recommendations
maya: tagging @jordan for overnight follow-up in case it reoccurs :eyes:
sam: handing off to night oncall @jordan in 20m — no customer impact observed
maya: closing thread, marking as noise/brief-spike. will include graphs in the follow-up ticket
opsbot: Note: INC-185999 closed (auto-resolved)
maya: :thumbsup:
